panels.title: Total S3 Requests
panels.description: This metric is expected in a healthy system. 'No data' indicates missing instrumentation or scrape failure.

panels.title: 4xx Errors
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and is only emitted on error. 'No data' indicates no 4xx errors observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: 5xx Errors
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and is only emitted on error. 'No data' indicates no 5xx errors observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Requests per Second
panels.description: This metric requires an optional exporter that is not deployed in this environment. ‘No data’ is expected.

panels.title: Requests by Method
panels.description: This metric requires an optional exporter that is not deployed in this environment. ‘No data’ is expected.

panels.title: Request Errors by Type
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and emitted only on failure. ‘No data’ indicates no events in the selected time range.
